orgDesign.companyProfile: Typical mid-size eMobility software company with distinct operator, roaming, driver, and fleet value streams supported by a shared platform team. The organization is now modeled as a network of smaller teams sized around 10 FTE.
orgDesign.operatingModel: Value-stream teams own operator and driver journeys end-to-end, while a platform team handles shared data, infrastructure, and analytics. Larger value streams are split into sibling teams so accountability stays close to concrete capability ownership.
designPrinciples: Operator reliability and driver experience have separate ownership because their delivery cadences differ.
Commercial settlement and interoperability stay close to roaming domain expertise.
Shared identity, data, and observability are standardized once for the full platform.
orgDesign.staffingPrinciple: Model total staffing around 250 FTE across delivery teams and group leadership; keep every delivery team at 6-10 FTE, with no individual team above 10 people.
orgDesign.groupingPrinciple: Use top-level groups for major value streams and a second layer of subgroups for team families when a stream contains multiple 10-FTE teams.
orgDesign.groupLeadershipPrinciple: Every group has explicit lightweight leadership: a Head of group, product and engineering directors, and principal/staff-plus IC coverage for architecture, product quality, and cross-team standards.
